text:
Olivia (product): Heads-up — we're trying to land a minimal set of GPU metrics for Hosted + Dedicated pools for the console dashboard. Need input on what's feasible from runtime/infra side.
Marco (eng-runtime): I can emit a few things from the runtime: SM occupancy, per-GPU memory_used and memory_total, request_queue_depth (per-worker), and per-model active_sessions.
Aisha (eng-infra): Agree those are useful. Need to decide label cardinality: pool_id, region, instance_type? High-cardinality model names could blow up TSDB.
Tom (eng-sre): For alerts + SLOs we probably need percentiles for SM occupancy and queue depth (p50/p95) and a rolling avg for memory pressure.
Priya (eng-ml): For Dedicated we also want to split by customer_tier (dedicated vs hosted) and model_precision (fp16/int8) since quant changes memory/SM behavior.
Marco (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: SM occupancy is sampled per-kernel and averaged across SMs every 5s. We can expose sm_occupancy{gpu_id, pool_id, model_family} as gauge. But model_family label is coarse to avoid cardinality.
Olivia (product): Product ask: Console should show heatmap by pool / region and a per-pool timeline. Also a compact card that shows "Capacity headroom" for autoscale decisions.
Aisha (eng-infra): For capacity headroom, infra needs a derived metric: headroom = sum_capacity - used_capacity (in slots or tokens/sec). We can compute in the query layer if we emit total_slots_per_pool and used_slots.
Marco (eng-runtime): We can emit used_slots_per_pool as an aggregate from workers, and total_slots_per_pool is static from infra API but we can push it into metrics as gauge on allocation changes.
Tom (eng-sre): Question: sampling rate and retention? For Hosted we want 1s granularity for a short window (1h) for operational debugging, 30s for longer (30d). Dedicated can be 5s/7d. TSDB cost will matter.
Priya (eng-ml): Another ML-specific metric: kv_cache_utilization (percent of KV cache in use) — impacts latency for long contexts. Can be per-model_family only.
Marco (eng-runtime): Ok we'll add kv_cache_utilization{pool_id, model_family}.
Olivia (product): UX ask: dashboard should permit comparing Hosted vs Dedicated for same model_family and show fallback events (when routing switched). Need routing switch logs correlated.
Aisha (eng-infra): We'll attach route_change events to metrics via tags in the event stream. Not a metric but logs/traces. Console can surface a small timeline of recent route changes next to the GPU chart.
Tom (eng-sre): For alerts: fire when sustained p95 queue_depth > threshold OR sm_occupancy > 90% for > 2m. Need advice from runtime on noise.
Marco (eng-runtime): sm_occupancy spikes during transient kernels. We should smooth with exponential moving average over 30s for alerting. Emit sm_occupancy_raw and sm_occupancy_ema.
Olivia (product): Nice. Also need a "blocked requests" count for OOMs and queue rejects.
Priya (eng-ml): Add out_of_memory_count and queue_reject_count labels: pool_id, model_family, error_type.
Aisha (eng-infra): We'll need to cap label values for error_type to small set.
Marco (eng-runtime): Logging format for metrics: 
```
# Prom-style metrics we will emit (examples)
sm_occupancy_raw{gpu_id="gpu-1",pool_id="hosted-eu",model_family="gpt2-like"} 67.2
sm_occupancy_ema{gpu_id="gpu-1",pool_id="hosted-eu",model_family="gpt2-like"} 54.1
memory_used_bytes{gpu_id="gpu-1",pool_id="hosted-eu"} 7200000000
memory_total_bytes{gpu_id="gpu-1",pool_id="hosted-eu"} 16000000000
request_queue_depth{worker_id="w-12",pool_id="hosted-eu"} 3
used_slots_per_pool{pool_id="hosted-eu"} 42
total_slots_per_pool{pool_id="hosted-eu"} 64
kv_cache_utilization{pool_id="dedicated-us",model_family="llama2-13b"} 0.73
```
Marco (eng-runtime): We'll push to pushgateway or push-pull via metrics scrape endpoint? We prefer push from services to metrics pipeline for ephemeral workers.
Aisha (eng-infra): Our pipeline accepts both. For Hosted workers we want scrape to avoid missing samples on restarts. For Dedicated, push is ok if we add heartbeat.
Tom (eng-sre): Who owns the dashboards? We need a cross-team folder and templated dashboards for on-call.
Olivia (product): Product owns the Console UX, but SRE will own default alerts and infra will own metric emission. We'll create a shared dashboard repo with JSON templates.
Priya (eng-ml): Can we add a small eval panel: model latency correlation with sm_occupancy and kv_cache_utilization? Helps root-cause.
Marco (eng-runtime): We'll expose per-model latency p50/p95 as app metrics with low-cardinality labels.
Aisha (eng-infra): Action items:
- Runtime (Marco): add metrics: sm_occupancy_raw, sm_occupancy_ema, memory_used/total, request_queue_depth, used_slots_per_pool, kv_cache_utilization, out_of_memory_count (ETA 2 wks).
- Infra (Aisha): expose total_slots_per_pool and ensure scrape vs push semantics documented (ETA 1 week).
- SRE (Tom): draft alerting rules and retention/sampling recommendations (ETA 3 days).
- Product (Olivia): wire Console panels: heatmap, capacity headroom, recent route changes, model correlation panel (ETA 2 weeks).
- ML (Priya): provide model_family grouping list and precision mapping to limit cardinality (ETA 3 days).
Marco (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR with proto for metric names + labels and sample payload.
Olivia (product): Great. @Aisha can you confirm the TSDB cost impact once we have cardinality numbers?
Aisha (eng-infra): Will run a cardinality estimate and post numbers in this thread. Expecting biggest contributors: model_family x pool x region combos.
Tom (eng-sre): Also add retention note: keep 1s for 1h for operational window, 30s for 30d. I'll add to alert doc.
Olivia (product): Thanks all. If there are objections on names/labels, reply here. Otherwise Marco please share the PR and we'll schedule a short sync next Tuesday to review dashboards. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Reminder — meeting scheduled: "GPU metrics rollout review" Tue 10:00.
Olivia (product): cool, see you all then."
